statement: Find all functions $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ such that $(x-y)f(x) + f(y) \leq f(x^2 - y^2)$ for all $x, y \in \mathbb{R}$.

Determine all integers $k \geq 1$ with the following property: if each integer is colored with one of $k$ colors, then there must exist integers $a_1 < a_2 < \cdots < a_{2023}$ of the same color such that the differences $a_2 - a_1, a_3 - a_2, \ldots, a_{2023} - a_{2022}$ are all powers of $2$.

Let $ABC$ be a triangle with incenter $I$ and circumcircle $\omega$. Let $N$ be the second intersection of line $AI$ with $\omega$. The line through $I$ perpendicular to $AI$ meets $BC$, $AB$, $AC$ at $D$, $E$, $F$ respectively. The circumcircle of $\triangle AEF$ meets $\omega$ again at $P$, and lines $PN$ and $BC$ meet at $Q$. Prove that lines $IQ$ and $DN$ intersect on $\omega$.
A positive integer $n$ is \textit{friendly} if adjacent digits (in base 10) differ by exactly $1$. Find all odd natural numbers $m$ for which there exists a friendly integer divisible by $64m$.
